name: needle
description: Dependencies for building the Needle FFGL plugin. GLEW is only needed on Windows; macOS uses the system OpenGL framework. There is nothing else: the ballistics are arithmetic, the font is a table in Font.cpp, and the meters read only the host's own FFT buffer. The VFD's audio comes from earshot, vendored as a snapshot under external/earshot, which brings miniaudio with it.
